subjects.description: A large adult kangaroo with reddish-grey fur, powerful muscular hind legs, a thick tapering tail, upright ears and a compact upper body
subjects.appearance_details: Sun-warmed rust-brown coat with paler cream underbelly, short forelimbs held close to the chest, alert erect ears, dark nose and eyes catching the low sun
subjects.relationship: The hazard that the ego vehicle must react to; sole animate subject on the road
subjects.location: Entering from right verge, moving toward center of the ego lane ahead
subjects.orientation: Body angled left across the road, partially side-on to camera
subjects.pose: Mid-bound crouch-and-extend hopping posture, hind legs coiling and extending, tail counterbalancing
subjects.action: Bounding in high arcing hops from the right verge into the ego lane and landing ahead of the vehicle
subjects.state_changes: Transitions from airborne bounds off the verge to landing squarely in the ego lane, then standing braced facing the stopped car

background_setting: A remote two-lane rural bitumen road cutting straight through open Australian scrubland. Flat dry earth, tufts of golden grass, low grey-green saltbush and scattered stunted trees line both verges. Faded painted lane markings run down the centre. The horizon is broad and empty under a clear pale-blue sky, with a low sun casting long shadows across the road surface.

lighting.conditions: Bright clear daytime with a low sun near the horizon
lighting.direction: Low side-lighting from the right, slightly behind the scene
lighting.shadows: Long stretched shadows of the kangaroo, roadside vegetation and posts cast across the tarmac toward the left
lighting.illumination_effect: Warm golden-hour glow with high contrast, rimming the kangaroo's fur and emphasizing texture on the road and scrub

aesthetics.composition: Centered ego-view down the road vanishing to the horizon, kangaroo entering from the right third and settling near center foreground of the lane
aesthetics.color_scheme: Warm earthy palette of ochre, dry gold, dusty grey-green scrub against a clear pale-blue sky and dark grey asphalt
aesthetics.mood_atmosphere: Tense, sudden hazard, alert, remote isolation
aesthetics.patterns: Repeating dashed centre-line road markings and evenly spaced roadside vegetation

cinematography.camera_motion: Forward-moving dashcam perspective at a moderate speed that brakes smoothly and continuously over two full seconds to a complete stop at 0:03.5, then holds completely static and locked off with no movement of any kind
cinematography.framing: Wide shot of the road ahead from driver's perspective
cinematography.focus: Sharp on the road ahead and the bounding kangaroo

context: Autonomous driving hazard-response demonstration of correct distance judgement and emergency braking for wildlife

actions.description: Ego vehicle travels forward at cruising speed along the empty rural road under low sun.
A large kangaroo appears at the right verge and begins bounding toward the road in high hops.
The vehicle applies smooth, firm, continuous braking. Its speed decreases steadily through the entire two seconds and it reaches a complete standstill by 0:03.5.

The vehicle brakes: The vehicle decelerates to a complete stop and remains stationary with the kangaroo standing ahead; the vehicle is parked and perfectly stationary and the camera does not move at all.
The vehicle is fully stopped and remains stationary; the vehicle is parked and perfectly stationary and the camera does not move at all.

segments.description: Steady forward travel down the two-lane rural road through open scrubland with long shadows.
segments.key_changes: Road ahead is clear; steady speed established.
segments.camera: Smooth forward tracking at cruising speed.

segments.description: A large kangaroo bounds from the right verge in high airborne hops and lands in the ego lane ahead.
segments.key_changes: Hazard enters from right; kangaroo lands in path; braking initiates.
segments.camera: Forward tracking begins to decelerate as brakes engage.

segments.description: The vehicle applies smooth, firm, continuous braking. Its speed decreases steadily through the entire two seconds and it reaches a complete standstill by 0:03.5.
segments.key_changes: Speed falls steadily from moderate to exactly zero across two full seconds; the forward motion of the scene slows visibly frame by frame until it ceases entirely at 0:03.5
segments.camera: Forward dashcam motion decelerating smoothly and continuously, coming to a complete rest at 0:03.5

segments.description: The vehicle is fully stopped and remains stationary. The camera does not translate at all: the framing is identical from 0:03.5 to 0:05, like a photograph; nothing in the scene moves.
segments.key_changes: Zero motion of any kind; the frame is static and locked off; everything holds exactly the same position in frame
segments.camera: Locked-off stationary camera, zero translation, zero vibration, as if mounted on a tripod in a parked car

temporal_caption: At 0:00, ego vehicle travels forward at cruising speed along the empty rural road under low sun. From 0:01.5 the vehicle brakes smoothly and continuously, its speed falling steadily. By 0:03.5 the vehicle has reached a complete standstill. From 0:03.5 to 0:05 the vehicle is parked and perfectly motionless: the camera does not translate at all and the framing is identical, like a still photograph.
audio_description: Ambient road and wind noise with tyre hum at cruising speed, a sudden firm brake actuation and tyre scrub as the vehicle decelerates, then near silence with faint outdoor scrubland ambience and light wind once the vehicle is fully stopped.
